english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone carries on as if nothing serious is happening.
This is the all-purpose choice when someone acts casually as though nothing is wrong or important.

examples.english: They blithely walked into the restaurant for dinner after just crashing someone else's car.
examples.traditional: 明明啱啱撞爛咗人哋部車，佢仲若無其事咁行入餐廳食飯。

examples.english: They ate nonchalantly despite hearing such serious news.
examples.traditional: 佢聽到咁大件事，都仲係若無其事咁食飯。
